name: Idaho
agency: Idaho Transportation Department (ITD), Division of Motor Vehicles

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night (ITD GDL fact sheet)
teen.holdPermit: 6 months, violation-free; a conviction cancels the permit and restarts the 6 months (ITD)
teen.nightLimit: Licensed drivers under 16: daylight only (half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset) unless a licensed person 21 or older is in the front seat
teen.passengerLimit: Licensed under 17, first 6 months: no more than one passenger under 17, relatives by blood, adoption or marriage excepted (Idaho Code 49-307)
teen.phone: All drivers: hands-free only (Idaho Code 49-1401A, since July 1, 2020), including at red lights and stop signs; one touch or voice to start a call; hand-held only when stationary outside travel lanes or in an emergency. Fines $75 / $150 / $300 within 3 years.

notes: Knowledge test: 40 questions, may miss up to 6 (ITD 'Taking the Driver's Test'); offered in Spanish; closed book, no devices.
Supervisor during SIP: licensed, at least 21, in the seat beside the driver; all occupants belted; SIP carried while driving (ITD GDL fact sheet).
Driver training required under 17: 30 h classroom, 6 h in-car observation, 6 h behind the wheel (ITD Young Drivers).
Minimum permit age: commercial practice-test sites say 14 and a half; not confirmed on an official page in this run, so permitAge is null.
Move Over: slow down and/or change lanes for stopped police, emergency, tow trucks and highway incident response vehicles (tow trucks and incident response added July 1, 2019).
Under 21 at 0.02 to under 0.08: license suspension of at least one year or until 21, whichever is longer (Idaho Code 18-8004A, per search summary).
